text:
sam: Heads-up: demo run for the Next LangChain starter showed duplicate embedding calls during hydration — users getting charged twice for the same doc.

anya: Ugh. I saw similar in the onboarding run yesterday. client fetch + server prewarm fighting each other. logs: 
```
[2025-04-02T11:03:02.301Z] WARN client embed /api/embed 429 Too Many Requests
[2025-04-02T11:03:02.312Z] INFO server prewarm /api/embed 200 OK
[2025-04-02T11:03:02.513Z] INFO client embed retry succeeded 200
```
lee: That pattern will be really confusing for new users. Quick patch: add a short-lived client-side lock (sessionStorage) to skip embedding if an in-flight key exists. Also reduce browser-side retry aggressiveness.

sam: Good short-term fix. Long-term we should support idempotency for embeddings so server can dedupe identical requests within a small window. That way, race wins don't double-bill.

anya: Agreed. Also propose default SDK behavior: server env -> retryOnRateLimit: true, browser env -> retryOnRateLimit: false. Browser should prefer backoff + UI fallback.

lee: I'll file a ticket and draft an SDK PR: (1) add x-redwood-idempotency header for embeddings, (2) implement server-side dedupe for identical idempotency keys within 10s, (3) change client retry defaults and add opt-in for aggressive retries.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-912: "Embeddings idempotency + browser retry defaults" assigned to lee. Priority: P2. :clipboard: 

deploy-bot: New branch created: sdk/embeddings-idempotency-lee. CI pipeline triggered.

anya: For the starter README I'll add a section "Avoid duplicate embeddings during hydration" with the sessionStorage pattern and a note to prefer server embeddings when possible.

sam: Can we also update the eval harness to assert "<=1 embedding per demo session"? That would catch regressions in CI.

lee: Yep will add an e2e test in the starter repo and a harness check. I'll include migration notes in the changelog for users relying on current retry behavior.

deploy-bot: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/578 - "embeddings: idempotency header + browser retry defaults". Running tests...

sam: Nice. Once merged let's run a smoke eval on the starter and confirm no latency regressions from the dedupe layer.

anya: On it, will run before EOD and report results here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
